    "name": "Bank Fraud Detection",

    "theme": "slide",
    "direction": "horizontal",
    "frame": { "title": "Real-time fraud detection on Databricks", "subtitle": "Ingest → features → model → real-time scoring → analyst insight" },

      { "id": "src-cards", "type": "source", "col": "sources", "row": 2, "label": "Card transactions", "icon": "sensorSource",

      { "id": "e4", "from": "lakeflow-genie-block", "to": "sql-lakehouse", "flow": true },

      { "id": "e6", "from": "training@b", "to": "registry@t", "label": "Register" },
      { "id": "e7", "from": "registry@b", "to": "serving@t", "label": "Deploy" },
      { "id": "e8", "from": "serving", "to": "ai-bi-dashboard", "flow": true, "label": "Fraud scores" },
      { "id": "e9", "from": "sql-lakehouse", "to": "genie", "flow": true,
